newsitem.title: USA: NCAA BASKETBALL-NINE MORE SCHOOLS EARN NCAA BASKETBALL TOURNAMENT BERTHS.
newsitem.headline: NCAA BASKETBALL-NINE MORE SCHOOLS EARN NCAA BASKETBALL TOURNAMENT BERTHS.

text.p: Nine schools earned automatic berths into the 64-team NCAA college basketball tournament by winning conference titles on Saturday, bringing the field to 26.
The final field for the NCAA Tournament will be set on Sunday, signalling the official start to "March Madness."
Four schools clinched automatic bids to the "Big Dance" Saturday night as Utah, Boston College, Montana and Jackson State won their conference championship games.
St. Joseph's, Coppin State, Southwest Texas State, Miami of Ohio and Marquette won earlier Saturday to claim coveted slots in the popular, high-profile NCAA Tournament.
Four more conference championships Sunday will complete the automatic berths with an NCAA selection committee to fill out the final 30 slots.

Third-ranked Utah (26-3) strengthened its case for a top seed in the NCAA's West Regional by disposing of Texas Christian in the final of the Western Athletic Conference tournament. Keith Van Horn scored 37 points to lead Utah to an 89-68 thumping of TCU.
Boston College (21-8) won its first Big East Conference title by beating Villanova 70-58.

One day after stunning 10th-ranked Cincinnati, Marquette (22-8) defeated North Carolina-Charlotte 60-52 in the Conference USA tournament championshp game. The win marked the first conference title for the Golden Eagles in men's basketball.
Montana (21-10) is in the NCAA Tournament for the first time since 1992 after posting an 82-79 victory over Cal State-Northridge in the Big Sky Conference final.

At 14-15, Jackson State became the second team in the NCAA field with a losing record. The Tigers defeated Mississippi Valley State 81-74, for the Southwestern Athletic Conference title. Doug Williams had 21 points to lead Jackson State to its first NCAA Tournament appearance.

St. Joseph's (24-6) is in the Tournament for the first time in 11 years after beating Rhode Island 61-56 for the Atlantic 10 Conference championship. Rashid Bey scored 18 points for the Hawks, who carry an eight-game winning streak into the Tournament.
Coppin State (20-8) shot 54 percent from the field to hold off North Carolina A&T 81-74 in the final of the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference tournament.
Southwest Texas State (16-12) is making its second NCAA Tournament appearance in four years following a 74-64 win over Northeast Louisiana for the championship of the Southland Conference.
Miami of Ohio earned a spot in the Tournament for the second time in three years by shooting 68 percent from the field in a 96-76 win over Eastern Michigan for the Mid-American Conference title.
Ira Newble scored 27 points and Wally Szczerbiak added 26 on sizzling 22-for-28 shooting to lead Miami.

Boston University, Tennessee-Chattanooga, Minnesota, UCLA, Princeton, Charleston Southern, College of Charleston, Murray State, Fairfield, Old Dominion, Illinois State, St. Mary's, Butler, Valparaiso, South Alabama, Navy and Long Island University had previously nailed down berths.
